Battle Instinct.name: Battle Instinct
Battle Instinct.description:
⚔️ Fights have taught you to move before you finish thinking.

👁️ You see the opening and the incoming blow a moment sooner.
📋 Requires level 8 and Combat Tactics 10.

📈 Grants: Dodging +5, Combat Tactics +5
Battle Instinct.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has fought enough to read a fight's rhythm by instinct: they shift away from a blow as it starts, notice when an opponent overcommits and keep track of everyone in view. Show it in quick, economical reactions and a calm sense of timing. Limits: it works on what they can perceive; an unseen attacker, a hidden Quirk or an ambush from outside their senses still catches them. It is experience, not foresight or a Quirk.
